title: Coherent higher direct images over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let F be a \mathcal O_X-module that is locally free of constant finite rank [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then for every q\geq0, H^q(X,F) is a finitely presented A-module.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma lemma-triviality-generic-fibre-valuation-ring, Tag 0EX8, proof using coherence of valuation rings and coherent cohomology

proof.text: Obtain a bounded finite projective A-module complex P with an A-linear isomorphism between the prescribed scalar-restricted cohomology module and H^q(P), using [lem-sc-valuation-proper-coherent-higher-direct-images-perfectness].

A valuation ring is Bezout. A finitely generated ideal I is principal. If I is zero it is finitely presented. Otherwise its nonzero generator yields a singleton basis by multiplication, so I is finite free and finitely presented. These are Mathlib IsBezout.isPrincipal_of_FG, Ideal.basisSpanSingleton and Module.finitePresentation_of_projective. Apply [lem-sc-coherent-ring-perfect-complex-cohomology] to P, its bounds and its finite projective terms, and transport finite presentation across the A-linear isomorphism with Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv.
